function.name: preview_demo
function.description: Render a self-contained HTML demo headless and return diagnostics (load ok, JS console errors, exceptions, DOM/canvas sanity, whether requestAnimationFrame ran). Returns a demo_id — reuse it for patches. Send the FULL html here only once; use patch_demo to iterate.

demo_id.description: reuse to replace an existing demo (rewrite fallback)

settle_ms.description: ms to wait after load before capture (default 700)

function.name: patch_demo
function.description: Apply small find/replace edits to a stored demo (by demo_id) and re-render. Each 'find' must match the stored HTML uniquely. On failure, re-send full html via preview_demo with the same demo_id.

function.name: save_demo
function.description: Persist a finished demo (by demo_id) to disk and surface a preview card in the chat. Call this once the demo renders cleanly.
